verdict.reason: Every numbered step stays within the mandate. The order matches the mandate on item, quantity, spending limit and exclusions, the buyer allowed the agent to pay, and the store charged and shipped exactly what was ordered. The buyer's complaint describes a different product from the one the mandate approved, so it does not change the result.
